project.title: Ten color pairings that make simple outfits look intentional
project.platform: Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels, YouTube Shorts

cast.woman_identity: Original adult woman in her late 20s, warm medium skin, deep brown eyes, medium-length dark auburn bob with a slight natural wave, expressive brows, slim natural build, 168 cm. Maintain same face and hairstyle in every look.
cast.man_identity: Original adult man in his early 30s, medium tan skin, dark brown eyes, neatly cropped dark brown hair with a natural hairline, lightly defined jaw, relaxed athletic build, 182 cm. Maintain same face and hairstyle in every look.

studio.description: A distinctive original fashion studio: pale limestone side wall, warm ivory pleated fabric backdrop, mid-tone walnut display plinth holding one small abstract clay sculpture at right, matte pale stone floor, soft daylight-style key from upper-left, gentle fill from the right, subtle floor shadows. Camera is at chest height, 35-50 mm full-frame equivalent lens, straight-on full-body two-person framing; fixed tripod; same floor marks and body scale.

scenes.title: Olive and cream
scenes.woman_outfit: Tailored olive short-sleeve knit polo, fluid ivory wide-leg trousers, thin chocolate leather belt, ivory low heels, compact cream structured handbag.
scenes.man_outfit: Olive relaxed unstructured blazer over off-white open-collar shirt, cream straight trousers and dark brown suede loafers.
scenes.action: Woman gives a small welcoming gesture toward the outfits; man turns his shoulders very slightly to show the blazer.

scenes.title: Burgundy and beige
scenes.woman_outfit: Deep burgundy fitted fine-gauge top with soft beige tailored trousers, pointed neutral shoes and understated brown shoulder bag.
scenes.man_outfit: Burgundy open-collar shirt tucked into beige pleated trousers, brown leather loafers, simple dark belt.
scenes.action: Woman tilts her head naturally toward camera; man adjusts one cuff once.

scenes.title: Navy and camel
scenes.woman_outfit: Deep navy fine-knit crew-neck top tucked into caramel-camel wide-leg tailored trousers with tan belt and nude leather shoes.
scenes.man_outfit: Navy lightweight blazer over textured midnight-blue shirt, camel tailored trousers and walnut loafers.
scenes.action: Woman lightly presents the camel trousers with one open hand; man makes a small relaxed weight shift.

scenes.title: Black and cream
scenes.woman_outfit: Black fitted long-sleeve crew-neck blouse with ivory high-rise wide trousers, minimal black handbag and black flat shoes.
scenes.man_outfit: Cream textured fine-knit long-sleeve top with tailored charcoal-black trousers, polished black loafers, minimal leather belt.
scenes.action: Both hold relaxed professional poses, subtle blinks and normal breathing; no large gestures.

scenes.title: Dusty pink and stone
scenes.woman_outfit: Muted dusty-pink short sleeve cashmere top tucked into stone-grey trousers with black slim shoulder bag.
scenes.man_outfit: Dusty-pink light knit over open collar, stone-grey tailored suit trousers, matching relaxed grey jacket and black loafers.
scenes.action: Woman smiles subtly and turns one palm toward the color palette; man glances toward her then back at camera.

scenes.title: Rust and ivory
scenes.woman_outfit: Brick-rust blouse with ivory fluid tailored trousers, warm brown handbag, pointed tan shoes.
scenes.man_outfit: Rust camp-collar shirt with clean ivory trousers, dark tan suede loafers and a quiet leather watch.
scenes.action: Woman moves her handbag naturally a few centimeters; man adjusts posture without changing position.

scenes.title: Chocolate and oat
scenes.woman_outfit: Chocolate brown soft cardigan over oat camisole with oat tailored trousers, simple brown leather shoulder bag.
scenes.man_outfit: Dark chocolate merino crew neck over a light shirt with oat trousers and dark brown loafers.
scenes.action: Both face camera, woman brushes the cardigan edge once and man rests a hand naturally in his pocket.

scenes.title: Slate blue and sand
scenes.woman_outfit: Slate blue airy blouse with high-waist sand-colored wide-leg trousers, light neutral handbag and ivory loafers.
scenes.man_outfit: Slate blue fine knit under relaxed powder-blue jacket, beige-sand trousers and brown suede shoes.
scenes.action: Woman lightly gestures to her trouser fabric; man briefly turns his head toward her.

scenes.title: Plum and charcoal
scenes.woman_outfit: Muted plum satin-look blouse with charcoal tailored straight-leg trousers, charcoal heels and small leather handbag.
scenes.man_outfit: Muted plum fine-gauge polo under charcoal relaxed blazer with charcoal wool trousers and black loafers.
scenes.action: A gentle, natural two-person pose with one understated hand movement from the woman.

scenes.title: Forest green and tan
scenes.woman_outfit: Forest-green structured short-sleeve blouse with tan pleated tailored trousers, slim leather bag and low pointed heels.
scenes.man_outfit: Forest-green open-collar knit polo with tan pleated trousers and dark walnut loafers.
scenes.action: Woman gives a final tiny satisfied nod to camera; man smiles gently without moving position.
